_doc: Single source of truth for the audio review: what every manifest key should sound like and when the game plays it. Read by tools/audio/review.py (review player + docs/AUDIO_REVIEW.md). `python3 tools/audio/review.py --check` fails if this and assets/audio/manifest.json disagree.

pistol_fire.expect: Real 9 mm handgun: hard snappy crack with a fat low-mid bark right behind it, a hint of slide clack, short outdoor tail; all takes are the same gun.

smg_fire.expect: Real 9 mm SMG: very fast, punchy pops with a tight low-mid body and almost no tail, so 900 rpm bursts stay separated.
smg_fire.when: Every Carrot SMG shot (900 rpm, full auto).

rifle_fire.expect: AR-15-style rifle: hard crack and tight thump in the first few ms, then one slap-back echo and a ~0.7 s outdoor tail.
rifle_fire.when: Every Carrot Assault Rifle shot (600 rpm, full auto).

lmg_fire.expect: Heavy, deep 7.62 shots: chunkier and lower than the rifle, faint belt rattle, ~0.3 s each.
lmg_fire.when: Every Carrot LMG shot (720 rpm, full auto).

shotgun_fire.expect: Regular 12-gauge pump: big boom with an audible low-mid body and low-end punch, real outdoor slap-backs, then a long rolling tail (~1.5 s).

sniper_fire.expect: .30-06 bolt rifle: huge crack over a deep, heavy thud, then a long rolling echo fading over ~2.6 s, with no dip in between.
sniper_fire.when: Every shot from The Long Carrot (sniper).

rocket_fire.expect: Deep whoosh-thump back-blast, the rocket motor roaring away, crackly sizzle (~2 s).

rocket_whoosh_loop.expect: Steady sputtery rocket roar with a slight spiralling wobble; the loop seam must be inaudible.
rocket_whoosh_loop.when: Loops on every rocket carrot in flight.

explosion.expect: Heavy, real-sounding blast: low boom, crunchy body, debris pattering down (~2 s).

shotgun_pump.expect: Real pump rack, "chk ... CHK": the forend slides back to the rear stop, then slams forward and locks (the louder stroke); crisp, no thuddy undertone.
shotgun_pump.when: Shotgun: racked 0.45 s after every shot (the burst preview plays it).

sniper_bolt.expect: Bolt cycle ending in a firm clack: dull lift click, bolt racked back onto its stop and shoved forward, then the handle snaps down into place (the loudest hit); damped steel, no ringing clinks; faint tick of the spent carrot stub.

scope_in.expect: Soft, quick rising "zip" with a gentle tone and a tiny click at the end.

reload_start.expect: Grip rustle, a two-part magazine-release click, the magazine sliding out with a solid clack, caught in the off hand.
reload_start.when: Start of every reload; also crate locks.

reload_end.expect: Magazine seated firmly (clack), then the bolt release slams the bolt home (CHAK, the loudest part) at ~0.12 s; over in ~0.25 s.

dry_fire.expect: Small, dry metallic click with a puff of air.
dry_fire.when: Pulling the trigger on an empty gun.

weapon_swap.expect: Quick draw: cloth/strap rustle, small sling-swivel rattle, a grip pat, ending in a sharp safety click-clack.

carrot_impact_dirt.expect: Hard, heavy thump into the ground with a dirt-and-grass crunch, a dirt spray and a few clods falling back.
carrot_impact_dirt.when: Carrots hitting the ground, rocks, props.

carrot_impact_wood.expect: One woody THOCK with a small splinter crack fused into the hit (no second 'tik').

carrot_impact_flesh.expect: Solid punch with a short, wet, meaty low-mid squelch; no droplets or bubbles.
carrot_impact_flesh.when: Your carrots hitting a critter (hit confirm).

headshot.expect: Comedic hollow BONK with falling pitch and a little cork pop (both takes).

gore_splat.expect: Hard body hit (fast low thump + heavy punch) under a meaty wet splat and squish, a few dark plips.
gore_splat.when: Gory kills with Gore: Full (a blast that tears a critter apart, or a headshot that pops the head off).

gore_limb_pop.expect: Cork-like POP, then a squelch, droplets and a fluff flick.
gore_limb_pop.when: A limb or head coming off.

body_fall.expect: Heavy soft thud crushing dry leaves and grass right at the start, a softer limb slap just after, a small settle; no bounce.
body_fall.when: A body hitting the ground 0.45 s after a critter dies (not after blasts), and the beaver's tail-slap jump landing.

footstep_grass.expect: Soft paw pad, then a crisp dry-grass/leaf crunch ~40 ms later; loud and easy to locate, still audible (muffled) from behind.

hop.expect: Soft rabbit landing, "pa-DUMP-shh": front paws, hind feet a beat later, a light brush of leaves; no boing, unobtrusive when repeated.
hop.when: Every bunny hop and bunny jump.

jump.expect: Quick upward whoosh with a scuff.

land.when: Landing from a jump or the glider.

glider_open.expect: Big two-stage canopy "fwa-POP": rustling unfurl, loud fabric snap and whump, a second smaller snap, then flutter that slows down.
glider_open.when: Popping the leaf/flower umbrella during the drop.

pickup_ammo.expect: Small clatter, a click, two rising plucked notes.

pickup_health.expect: Bright rising chime sparkle over a warm chord.
pickup_health.when: Picking up or eating a lucky clover.

pickup_armor.expect: Woody acorn knock and clink, then three rising bell tones.

pickup_weapon.expect: Metal latch, then a deep, warm rolled harp chord.

crate_open.expect: Creaking lid and wooden knock, then a breathy wooden-flute flourish (run, trill, held note) with a faint harp chord underneath.
crate_open.when: Opening crates, treasure chests and supply drops.

armor_break.expect: Acorn armor breaking apart like a little contraption: a crunchy shell crack, then a metal clasp snaps open, a plate pops off, a small spring sproings loose and the pieces clatter away.

hurt_squeak.expect: Short, deep, gritty critter pain cries: a yelp, "ak-ak" chatter, a growly chirr, a grunt into a yip, a raspy whine, a low strained "ngh".

death_squeak.expect: Real small-animal death squeals (rat recordings slowed to critter size, not synth): a long sinking squeal, an "eek!" then a lower dying squeal, a squeal with one last weak gasp; each ends in a breath.

ambient_forest_loop.expect: Gentle breeze and leaves, crickets, occasional birds; seamless 10 s loop.
ambient_forest_loop.when: Background bed for the whole match.

wind_loop.expect: Gusty high-altitude wind with a faint whistle; seamless loop.

storm_loop.expect: Low rumble and swirling wind with a dense, dry thorny crackle and an ominous hum; no clinks or plops; seamless loop.
storm_loop.when: Comes from the nearest edge of the Briar storm wall.

storm_damage_tick.expect: Dry, woody clock tick (tick-TOCK within ~25 ms) with a prickle of thorns; no tone, drone or ring (both takes are the same clock).
storm_damage_tick.when: Each second you take Briar damage.

ui_hover.expect: Soft, whimsical harp glissando swipe (5 quick rising notes into a ringing high note), under 0.35 s.

match_countdown_go.expect: Brighter two-tone "GO!" beep with a bell ring.

victory_fanfare.expect: Rock sting in D: snare pickup, one bar of distorted power-chord riff over a kick/snare rock beat, a dead stop with a tom fill + reverse cymbal, then the loudest moment: a huge low D chord + kick/snare/crash, held with a tin-whistle run to a high D, fading out by 3 s.
victory_fanfare.when: Winner Winner Carrot Dinner! (starts with the victory music, same key and tempo).

music/menu_monkeys_spinning_monkeys.mp3.title: Monkeys Spinning Monkeys
music/menu_monkeys_spinning_monkeys.mp3.expect: Light, happy flutes and pizzicato — cartoon woodland.

music/match_run_amok.mp3.title: Run Amok
music/match_run_amok.mp3.expect: Orchestral comedy chase with lots of energy.

music/match_bushwick_tarantella.mp3.title: Bushwick Tarantella
music/match_bushwick_tarantella.mp3.expect: Frantic accordion and clarinet — final-circle panic.

music/victory_fiddles_mcginty.mp3.title: Fiddles McGinty
music/victory_fiddles_mcginty.mp3.expect: Driving Celtic folk-rock reel: pipes, recorder, guitar, rock backbeat.
music/victory_fiddles_mcginty.mp3.when: Victory screen (fades in under the victory_fanfare sting).
